definitions.short: Jeshurun , a symbolic name for Israel
definitions.full: H3484. Yeshurun יְשֻׁרוּן proper name, masculine ( upright one ) Deut 32:15 ; 33:5 , 26 ; Isa 44:2 ; poetic name of Israel, designating it under its ideal character, ᵐ5 ὁ ἠγαπημένος , Aq Symm Theod εὐθύς , ᵑ9 rectissimus, dilectus ; Thes Ew § 167 a Lag BN 33 regard it as diminutive from יָשׁוּר = good little people ; but no evidence that וּן +? § 86 (2). 4 take as denominative = Rechtvolk ; Bacher ZAW v, 1885, 161 ff. and Che rightly compare הַיָּשָׁר סֵפֶר (see יָשָׁר 3e ).
